verdicts.reason: A keeps a strong large '20% off' headline and the circle-behind-bottle motif, but the eyebrow sits inline with the headline, the copy is jammed against the CTA, and the bottle crowds the top and bottom edges. B shrinks the headline, floats it low and misaligned with the eyebrow, leaves the body copy detached, and puts the bottle in the middle with the CTA stranded at the right. The circle is cropped into an unrelated corner blob, so hierarchy and grouping are weak and the design looks scattered.
